name: Wilfred (tto-agent)
description: AI assistant for technology transfer offices. Django 6 + Channels (WebSocket chat) + Celery, multi-provider LLM, and pgvector RAG over uploaded data rooms.

DJANGO_ALLOWED_IP_RANGES.description: Optional comma-separated inbound client IPs/CIDRs. Empty allows all clients; NTNU example: 129.241.0.0/16.

DJANGO_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated origins, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com. Required or form posts return 403.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Required: pgvector embeddings + OpenAI LLM provider.

LLM_DEFAULT_CHEAP_MODEL.description: Fast model for descriptions and classification.

PGBOUNCER_POOL_MODE.description: In-dyno PgBouncer pool mode. Keep 'transaction' — required by disable_server_side_cursors in settings.py.

PGBOUNCER_DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE.description: Real Postgres connections PgBouncer opens per dyno (web and worker each ~ this many). 5 for essential-0 (20-conn cap), 10 for essential-2 (40), 25 for standard-0 (120).

PGBOUNCER_MAX_CLIENT_CONN.description: Max app-side connections to the in-dyno PgBouncer (cheap; lets app concurrency exceed the real pool size).

SUBAGENT_WORKER_SLOTS.description: Max sub-agents executing at once, system-wide. The sub-agent memory lever on the worker; applies on the next dispatch, no restart. Production runs 8.

SUBAGENT_MAX_SYSTEM.description: Max sub-agents waiting + running system-wide (the queue depth). Above it a spawn is refused with 'system busy'. Production runs 24.

SUBAGENT_MAX_PER_USER.description: Max sub-agents waiting + running per user. Hard deny; the orchestrator prompt states this number.

RERANK_ON_WORKER.description: Enable FlashRank rerank on the Celery worker. Default false. FlashRank/onnxruntime is ~45MB resident (TinyBERT + onnxruntime session); on its own this flag won't get a real workload under the 512MB cap (the shared LLM/ML stack dominates — tiktoken alone is ~80MB), but keeping it off avoids stacking that extra ~45MB toward the R15 kill under concurrency. Main-chat rerank is controlled by RERANK_ENABLED. Enable only after a Standard-2X bump gives headroom; worker restart required.

MALLOC_ARENA_MAX.description: Caps glibc malloc arenas to reduce Celery threads-pool memory fragmentation. Worker restart required to take effect.

SLIDES_ENABLED.description: Global kill-switch for the AI slide-deck feature. Per-org rollout is the 'slide_deck_collaborator' seed skill's org enablement. Default true.

SLIDE_RENDER_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds a single LibreOffice pptx->pdf conversion may run before it's killed (process-group). Default 120.

SLIDE_RENDER_CONCURRENCY.description: Max concurrent LibreOffice renders on the worker (semaphore bound; the ~200-300MB spike is per-render). Default 1.

SENTRY_DSN.description: Optional: error tracking. Disabled if unset.

EMAIL_SENDING_ENABLED.description: Optional: enable outbound email (Mailgun backend). Default false.
